title: spec(i18n): translateObject writes translated field help onto an undeclared `help` key — the console warns ~520× per page load and drops the value
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect — `reach:` measured once through a public entry (`GET /api/v1/meta/object/:name`, then the console UI).
Reader: triage seat first-touch → the lane that owns `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` (expected `domain:spec`); one fix PR.
Dedup (semantic search, open + closed): objectstack "served object field carries undeclared help key, ingestion choke point cannot canonicalize retired spelling help, inlineHelpText translateObject" → 0 hits; objectui "retired spelling help warning console field help" → 7 hits, all closed, none about a served `help` key (nearest: objectui#10471, objectui#10176 — different keys).

## What happens

The metadata read seam overlays translated field help onto the served field def under the key `help`:

- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `translateObject` → `translateField`: `const translatedHelp = lookupObjectFieldAttr(bundle, objectName, name, 'help', opts); if (translatedHelp) next.help = translatedHelp;`

`FieldSchema` declares no `help` key. Help text is `inlineHelpText` (and `description`); the field conversion table in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` already lists `help` as an alias spelling of `inlineHelpText`. So the served field shape carries a key the contract does not declare, on every field whose translation bundle has a `help` entry.

## Reach — measured on a stock showcase boot

Framework `ce577ec4` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`, fresh SQLite), objectui at `f9f4a62d` (console dev server).

1. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_user` as the seeded admin → **18 of 27 fields carry `help`**. Sample, `two_factor_enabled`: `help` = `description` = "Whether two-factor authentication is enabled for this user. Maintained by the better-auth `twoFactor` plugin."; no `inlineHelpText`.
2. Showcase's own objects carry none (`GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_task` → 0 of 25), so it is the platform objects whose packages ship translation bundles with `help` entries (e.g. `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.objects.generated.ts`).
3. Sign in to the console and load any authenticated page → the console's ingestion step logs one warning per such field, e.g.

   ```text
   [ObjectUI] Object `sys_user`, field `two_factor_enabled`: the ingestion choke point CANNOT canonicalize the retired spelling `help`. `FieldSchema` declares neither `help` nor any key sharing its alias spelling ... The key and its value are LEFT on the def
   ```

   **523 warnings on one page load, across 73 `sys_*` objects**, repeated on every full load. The value is not rendered.

## Expected

The served field def carries only keys `FieldSchema` declares, so a consumer renders the translated help it is sent, and an authenticated page load logs zero warnings for platform objects.

## Not measured

Whether a non-English locale serves a `help` value that differs from `description` (i.e. whether a translation is actually lost to users today, beyond the warnings). The en-US sample above has `help` equal to `description`.

Provenance: maintainer instruction in the dispatching session, verbatim — 「把这些问题提成 issue」. Found during a browser dogfood sweep of the console; filed by session `session_01WEARdKfDHDT7rTuEhLyT1k`.
